planned_pairing.expected_pairing: one matched treatment and no-factor episode for every selected validation seed and applicable factor case

resolved_category_domain.matching_rule: category.split("/")[1] == "trench"; exact segment equality, never substring matching

contact_semantics.event: actual physical contact between two robots, identified by simulator robot-to-robot contact-pair/contact impulse signals
contact_semantics.excluded_event: robot interaction with field bump terrain; terrain collision/contact is not robot-to-robot contact
contact_semantics.realization: a requested geometry is realized only when the corresponding robot-to-robot contact signal is recorded in the episode; requested setup alone is not contact exposure
contact_semantics.recovery_event: recovery begins at the recorded end of robot-to-robot contact and ends at the first subsequent recorded return to the pre-contact route-following state; both event timestamps and the route-following state must be present
contact_semantics.thresholds_or_margins: none declared; no minimum contact impulse, distance, duration, or recovery-performance threshold is implied
